![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14057099/assets/1a46390ced6cc52c535f9f48e5e157cea83960caa339e98b23e3b64c93e0ea38.png)

Calculate ${\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s,$ where $C$ is the line segment shown above.
worked_solution:
The line integral of unity with respect to arc length over $C$ is equal to the arc length $L$ of $C,$ i.e.,

$$
{\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s=L.
$$

In this case, the path $C$ is a line segment directed along the $y$-axis. Therefore, we have

$$
{\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s=3-(-1)=4.
$$
